name: Garware Offshore Services Limited
about: Garware Offshore Services Limited engages in the owning, operation, and charter of offshore support vessels in India. Its vessels provide support services for oil and gas exploration activities, including transporting personnel to rigs and platforms from onshore bases; delivering cargo, material to rigs, and platforms; anchor handling. The company also offers towing rigs, as well as providing support services for offshore and underwater construction projects. The company was formerly known as Global Offshore Services Limited and changed its name to Garware Offshore Services Limited in February 2026. Garware Offshore Services Limited was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Mumbai, India.
